the-ordinary-glycolic-acid-7-exfoliating: Glycolic toner that smooths texture and brightens. Many keep it to a couple of nights weekly.
the-ordinary-niacinamide-10-zinc-1: Budget serum for less oil and clearer-looking pores. Some mix a few drops into moisturizer instead.
the-ordinary-aha-30-bha-2-peeling-soluti: Short-contact peel for smoother, brighter skin, usually weekly or less. Keep it brief, on dry skin.
paulas-choice-skin-perfecting-2-bha-liqu: Leave-on BHA for clogged pores and blackheads, often a few times a week. Tolerance varies.
la-roche-posay-toleriane-hydrating-gentl: Creamy, non-foaming cleanser that feels comfortable on dry skin. Stinging comes up for some.
la-roche-posay-cicaplast-balm-b5: Rich, soothing balm for dry, stressed skin at night. Oily skin may find it heavy.
supergoop-glowscreen-spf-40: Glowy tinted sunscreen that doubles as a light base. Some find it greasy or too shimmery.
cosrx-advanced-snail-92-all-in-one-cream: Sticky gel cream for oily skin and warm weather. Dry skin often calls in richer backup.
cosrx-advanced-snail-96-mucin-power-esse: Gooey, hydrating essence for soft, plump skin. Small closed bumps are the main complaint.
cerave-hydrating-facial-cleanser: Non-foaming cleanser that leaves dry skin comfortable. Best as a morning or second cleanse.
tatcha-the-dewy-skin-cream: Dense, hydrating cream for dry skin on winter nights. Oily skin may find it heavy.
cerave-pm-facial-moisturizing-lotion: Fast-absorbing lotion that hydrates morning and night. Very dry skin may want more.
the-ordinary-caffeine-solution-5-egcg: Budget eye serum that eases morning puffiness for a while. Dark circle results are mixed.
the-inkey-list-oat-cleansing-balm: Budget cleansing balm that melts makeup and sunscreen. The tube makes you work for it.
first-aid-beauty-ultra-repair-cream: Thick, easy-spreading cream for dry winter skin. Eucalyptus oil gets blamed for some stinging.
cerave-am-facial-moisturizing-lotion-wit: Moisturizer with sunscreen in one step, but pilling is the main complaint by far.
neutrogena-hydro-boost-hyaluronic-acid-w: Fresh, cooling gel that hydrates oily skin without grease. The fragrance-free version wins many over.
skin1004-hyalu-cica-water-fit-sun-serum: Featherweight sunscreen serum with a dewy finish. Moist enough that your moisturizer gets the day off.
tatcha-the-water-cream: Gel-like moisturizer for oily skin and daytime. The price tag is the heaviest thing about it.
avene-cicalfate-restorative-protective-c: Thick, soothing cream for redness-prone skin and retinoid days. Can feel heavy in summer.
glow-recipe-plum-plump-hyaluronic-cream: Lightweight day moisturizer that layers well under sunscreen. Pricey, and may need backup at night.
hada-labo-tokyo-skin-plumping-gel-cream: Hydrating gel cream that rarely pills under sunscreen in humid weather. Breakouts are the main risk.
the-ordinary-soothing-barrier-support-se: Soothing serum for dry skin and actives like tretinoin. Results are split, especially on sensitive skin.
the-inkey-list-salicylic-acid-cleanser: Blackhead-fighting salicylic acid cleanser that many say clears pores without drying.
stratia-lipid-gold: Dewy, barrier-repairing layer for dry, flaky skin. Niacinamide-sensitive skin may want to skip it.
the-ordinary-multi-peptide-ha-serum: Quick-absorbing peptide serum that plumps and smooths. Some long-term daily users swear by it.
cosrx-aha-7-whitehead-power-liquid: Gentle AHA that many say clears closed comedones and bumps. The smell is the common gripe.
cosrx-acne-pimple-master-patch: Strong pimple patch that sticks well and flattens surfaced spots overnight. Less useful on deep ones.
cosrx-the-vitamin-c-23-serum: Potent vitamin C for brightening and even tone. The strong smell is the main complaint.
beauty-of-joseon-ginseng-essence-water: Calming, lightweight essence that some rebuy. Many find it only mildly hydrating.
stratia-soft-touch-aha: Very gentle AHA that smooths texture, even alongside tretinoin. Some want it a little stronger.
cosrx-aha-bha-clarifying-treatment-toner: Pore-smoothing toner that suits some sturdy or dry skin. Irritation is the main complaint.
the-ordinary-vitamin-c-suspension-23-ha-: Strong vitamin C with a greasy, gritty texture. Potent stuff, and not a beginner pick.
anua-heartleaf-pore-control-cleansing-oi: Cleansing oil that lifts sebum from pores, but most reviews here report breakouts.
skin1004-centella-soothing-cream: Fast-absorbing gel-cream that calms redness. Cold, dry weather needs something richer.
kravebeauty-matcha-hemp-hydrating-cleans: Matcha cleanser that leaves skin soft, not stripped. Holy grail status, earned at the sink.
first-aid-beauty-facial-radiance-pads: Exfoliating pads for smoother texture and even tone, used once or twice a week.
aveeno-calm-restore-triple-oat-serum: Simple, soothing serum for dry, barrier-damaged skin that sits well under makeup.
drunk-elephant-a-passioni-retinol-cream: Strong retinol cream, so start slowly. Many buffer it or use it only some nights.
cosrx-salicylic-acid-daily-gentle-cleans: Salicylic cleanser for oil and blackheads that many use daily. Long use can leave skin dry.
beauty-of-joseon-green-plum-refreshing-t: Plum toner with gentle acids that smooths texture and fades marks. Plenty of fans repurchase.
the-inkey-list-caffeine-eye-cream: Good-value eye cream that de-puffs for some. Dark circles rarely change.
eltamd-uv-clear-broad-spectrum-spf-46: Non-greasy sunscreen with no white cast. Pilling over moisturizer is the common gripe.
cerave-resurfacing-retinol-serum: Low-key retinol for smoother texture and even tone. A reasonable starter pick.
aveeno-calm-restore-oat-gel-moisturizer: Quick-absorbing gel that hydrates without clogging. Pilling under sunscreen is the main downside.
anua-azelaic-acid-10-hyaluron-redness-so: Hydrating azelaic serum for calmer redness and more even tone. Several find it sticky.
haruharu-wonder-black-rice-moisture-airy: Comfortable sunscreen with a velvety finish and no white cast. Many fans name it a favorite.
cerave-foaming-facial-cleanser: Foaming cleanser that suits some oily skin, though many find it drying or clogging.
skin1004-madagascar-centella-ampoule: Watery ampoule that calms redness and supports a stressed barrier, often next to actives.
cerave-healing-ointment: Thick night occlusive and chapped-lip rescue. Expect sticky, because that is how it stays put.
torriden-dive-in-soothing-cream: Cooling gel moisturizer for oily skin and humid summers. Winter might want a thicker coat.
axis-y-dark-spot-correcting-glow-serum: Light gel serum that fades fresh marks for many. Older spots change less.
glow-recipe-watermelon-glow-pha-bha-pore: Hydrating, gentle toner that many rebuy. The scent debate is candy versus cucumber.
vanicream-moisturizing-cream: Thick, fragrance-free cream at a good price. Slow to absorb, so it can sit on top.
cerave-skin-renewing-night-cream: Rich, hydrating night cream that never feels greasy. A few just wish the jar were bigger.
cerave-daily-moisturizing-lotion: Long-time staple for very dry skin, though recent reviews lean negative on the reformulation.
torriden-dive-in-low-molecular-hyaluroni: Scent-free hyaluronic serum that hydrates fast. It plays opening act, so a cream usually follows.
cetaphil-gentle-skin-cleanser: Lotion-like cleanser for sensitive skin. Some long-time fans dislike the reformulated version.
cosrx-low-ph-good-morning-gel-cleanser: Cheap gel cleanser that lasts and lasts. Clean skin, minus the squeaky soundtrack.
cosrx-full-fit-propolis-synergy-toner: Slightly thick, non-sticky toner that hydrates and leaves a soft glow.
cerave-renewing-sa-cleanser: Salicylic wash for blackheads, best left on a couple of minutes if your skin tolerates it.
paulas-choice-10-azelaic-acid-booster: Well-tolerated azelaic booster for clearer skin and fewer marks. Can pill under sunscreen.
cosrx-bha-blackhead-power-liquid: Mild BHA that smooths texture for some. Many saw no change on blackheads.
bioderma-sensibio-h2o-micellar-water: Gentle micellar water that lifts makeup and sunscreen. Mineral SPF may need an encore.
laneige-water-sleeping-mask: Light, dewy final step that seals in your layers. More nightcap than heavy duvet.
cerave-ultra-light-moisturizing-lotion-s: Truly lightweight SPF lotion, soft matte finish, no white cast. Oily skin loves it.
beauty-of-joseon-revive-eye-serum-ginsen: Retinal eye serum that many find gentle, with slow, subtle results. Dark circles rarely budge.
cosrx-aloe-soothing-sun-cream-spf-50: Gentle, hydrating sunscreen that many save for winter. Basically the cozy sweater of sun creams.
beauty-of-joseon-glow-deep-serum-rice-al: Brightening serum that fades dark marks and evens tone over weeks. Results vary.
haruharu-wonder-black-rice-hyaluronic-to: Non-sticky hydrating toner that feels lovely, though some report new bumps.
drunk-elephant-lala-retro-whipped-cream: Whipped moisturizer that fans find rich and gentle. Skin type matters, and the price divides people.
cosrx-the-6-peptide-skin-booster-serum: Gentle peptide serum that hydrates nicely. Many say it acts more like a hydrating toner.
supergoop-mineral-mattescreen-spf-40: Mattifying, slightly tinted mineral SPF that works like a primer. Makeup gets a smooth runway.
avene-thermal-spring-water: Calming mist with a satisfying spray. One skeptic calls it expensive water, but fans keep spritzing.
torriden-solid-in-ceramide-cream: Rich but fast-absorbing, fragrance-free ceramide cream for dry skin and barrier support.
eltamd-uv-physical-broad-spectrum-spf-41: Tinted mineral SPF with a satin finish and no sting. The tint suits light skin best.
kravebeauty-great-barrier-relief: Barrier product that many call a holy grail, even alongside tretinoin. Not right for everyone.
numbuzin-no-3-super-glowing-essence-tone: Essence toner for hydration and a smoother glow. Can be too much for reactive skin.
beauty-of-joseon-green-plum-refreshing-c: Mild, light-foaming cleanser that leaves skin soft. Best for anyone wanting something simple.
first-aid-beauty-pure-skin-face-cleanser: Gentle cleanser with fans loyal for a decade. Few routines get that kind of devotion.
drunk-elephant-t-l-c-framboos-glycolic-n: Glycolic night serum that brightens and smooths for fans. Pricey, and results are hit or miss.
beauty-of-joseon-red-bean-refreshing-por: Gentle clay-style mask that leaves skin soft. No dried-mud feeling, which is a nice change.
the-inkey-list-hyaluronic-acid-serum: Cheap hyaluronic serum that sinks in without stickiness. Your wallet stays hydrated too.
byoma-milky-toner: Milky toner that many rebuy for soft, deep hydration. Gentle for many, not for everyone.
supergoop-play-everyday-lotion-spf-50: Moisturizing SPF with a dewy finish, no white cast. The citrus scent arrives before you do.
laneige-cream-skin-toner-moisturizer: Cream toner that also moisturizes, saving a step and a spot on the shelf.
mario-badescu-drying-lotion: Overnight spot treatment that shrinks whiteheads by morning. Less effective on deep spots.
naturium-niacinamide-serum-12-plus-zinc-: Fast-absorbing niacinamide serum that skips pilling. The high strength does not suit everyone.
the-ordinary-100-plant-derived-squalane: Light, non-greasy squalane that even oily skin tolerates well. Opposites really do attract.
cosrx-balancium-comfort-ceramide-cream: Thick, hydrating ceramide cream with a bergamot scent. Some find it sits on top.
byoma-moisturizing-gel-cream: Oil-friendly gel cream that some call a holy grail. A newer bottle broke some users out.
sunday-riley-ice-ceramide-moisturizing-c: Rich ceramide cream with a cooling feel. The name is not just for show.
mixsoon-bean-essence: Soft-feeling bean essence with a mild exfoliating effect. Some get small bumps.
peach-lily-glass-skin-refining-serum: Glowy serum for a plump look on dry, oily and combination skin. Results can be temporary.
sunday-riley-c-e-o-15-vitamin-c-brighten: Lotion-like vitamin C serum that brightens and evens tone, especially on dry skin.
axis-y-complete-no-stress-physical-sunsc: Mineral sunscreen with a mild white cast that fades. The earthy mugwort scent is strong.
cetaphil-moisturizing-cream: Reliable, hydrating cream for dry skin that doesn't clog pores for most.
la-roche-posay-toleriane-purifying-foami: Foaming face wash that many find gentle and non-stripping. Others found it drying.
beauty-of-joseon-ginseng-cleansing-oil: Gentle cleansing oil that removes makeup and helps break down blackheads.
beauty-of-joseon-radiance-cleansing-balm: Rinse-clean balm that melts makeup and sunscreen. Waterproof makeup is its one tough customer.
stratia-velvet-cleansing-milk: Hydrating cleansing milk that never leaves skin tight. A few bottles reportedly spoiled.
la-roche-posay-toleriane-double-repair-f: Sunscreen moisturizer that spreads easily and protects well. Some find it greasy.
the-ordinary-alpha-arbutin-2-ha: Alpha arbutin serum for fading dark marks, gentle for some. A sizable group broke out.
paulas-choice-clinical-1-retinol-treatme: Effective retinol for some long-term fans. Too strong for others, and costly to keep up.
drunk-elephant-c-firma-fresh-day-serum: Vitamin C day serum with a few devoted fans. Strong smell and quick oxidizing are complaints.
glow-recipe-watermelon-glow-aha-night-tr: Night treatment that fans of the original loved. Many found the reformulated version irritating.
glow-recipe-watermelon-glow-ultra-fine-m: Fruity, hydrating mist for toning or setting makeup. Glow with a side of fruit salad.
the-inkey-list-10-azelaic-acid-serum: Azelaic serum that fans like for redness and marks. Results look unpredictable.
the-ordinary-natural-moisturizing-factor: Quick-absorbing, good-value hydrator for dry skin. Can feel heavy or greasy for some.
beauty-of-joseon-relief-sun-rice-probiot: Moisturizing sunscreen with no white cast and little eye sting. Oily skin may find it heavy.
cerave-moisturizing-cream: Thick, basic cream for dry skin and a damaged barrier. Some get breakouts, mostly on oily skin.
vanicream-gentle-facial-cleanser: Basic, non-stripping cleanser for sensitive skin. Follow with moisturizer, since some feel tight.
beauty-of-joseon-relief-sun-aqua-fresh-r: Very light, fast-absorbing sunscreen, less shiny than the original Relief Sun. Can pill when layered.
la-roche-posay-toleriane-double-repair-f: Hydrating moisturizer for dry skin. Pilling under sunscreen and breakouts are common complaints.
cosrx-ultimate-nourishing-rice-overnight: Rich sleeping pack for dry skin. Breakouts come up, more on oily skin or in summer.
tatcha-the-rice-wash: Creamy, gentle rice cleanser that leaves skin clean. Pricey, but a tiny dab does the job.
sunday-riley-good-genes-lactic-acid-trea: Lactic acid treatment for smoother, brighter skin a few nights a week. Pricey for some.
glow-recipe-watermelon-glow-niacinamide-: Dew drops for priming or mixing into foundation. The candy scent and tacky feel divide fans.
cerave-eye-repair-cream: Basic eye moisturizer that sits well under concealer. Little effect on dark circles.
numbuzin-no-5-glutathione-vitamin-concen: Lightweight brightening serum that fades marks over months. Patience required.
beauty-of-joseon-dynasty-cream: Very hydrating night cream for dry skin. Tacky to the touch, classy on the shelf.
beauty-of-joseon-glow-serum-propolis-nia: Hydrating serum with a subtle glow. Many see little beyond hydration for the price.
vanicream-daily-facial-moisturizer: Plain, lightweight lotion for sensitive skin. Some get stinging instead, so results vary.
aveeno-calm-restore-nourishing-oat-clean: Oat cleanser that is very gentle, best as a mild or second cleanse. Sunscreen needs more.
cerave-hydrating-cream-to-foam-cleanser: Cream-to-foam cleanser that removes makeup for many. Others find it drying.
neutrogena-hydro-boost-gel-cream-extra-d: Fragrance-free gel-cream that hydrates gently. The jar disappears faster than expected.
supergoop-unseen-sunscreen-spf-50: Clear, primer-like sunscreen with no white cast. The silicone feel splits opinion.
kiehls-ultra-facial-cream: Fairly light cream that hydrates and sinks in. Can pill under makeup or sunscreen.
the-ordinary-azelaic-acid-suspension-10: Thick azelaic suspension for redness and marks. It pills over other products for many.
the-ordinary-squalane-cleanser: Balm-style cleanser that melts makeup. Waterproof formulas and sunscreen can hang on.
